description: Backend currency correctness for the unified dashboard. (a) Replace the hardcoded currencyConversionService.inrToUsd(...) in DashboardDataService.aggregateGcpDashboardData with a per-project, billed-rate USD conversion so a USD-billed GCP project is passed through unchanged (not divided by ~83) and a non-USD project is converted at GCP's own currency_conversion_rate, with the project currency surfaced. (b) Fix mapAzureDataToDashboardData so forecast (and lastMonthSpend / unified cost history) are USD-consistent with the already-USD monthToDateSpend instead of native. Mirrors the merged Azure pattern. Independent of FEAT-002 in code, but MUST land first because FEAT-002 (frontend) relies on the backend now emitting GCP USD.
steps: Read context.json and this file FIRST. Then read DashboardDataService.aggregateGcpDashboardData (~L1477), mapAzureDataToDashboardData (~L3560), GcpCostService.getUnfilteredMonthToDateSpendSync (~L396) and getProjectCurrencyCode (~L1053), GcpBillingSql.NET_COST_SUM, CurrencyConversionService.inrToUsd, and the Azure reference fields in AzureDashboardData.java (currency, monthToDateSpendUsd + Javadoc).

In GcpCostService, add a billed-rate USD MTD method, e.g. `public Optional<Double> getUnfilteredMonthToDateSpendUsd(String gcpProjectId, boolean forceRefresh)` (plus the no-forceRefresh overload for parity). Run the SAME month-to-date window query as getUnfilteredMonthToDateSpendSync but select the USD expression: SUM over (net cost / currency_conversion_rate), i.e. divide the NET_COST_SUM components by currency_conversion_rate at row level (reuse the credit sub-select shape from GcpBillingSql.NET_COST_SUM). Cache it under a distinct key alongside the native MTD. Return Optional.empty() when getBillingTableName is absent, when the export has no currency_conversion_rate column, or on query failure, so callers can fall back. Do NOT touch the CSP/reseller branch beyond leaving it returning empty (CSP projects keep native + fallback).

In DashboardDataService.aggregateGcpDashboardData, delete the three inrToUsd calls at ~L1515-1517 and the two inside the cost-history (~L1595) and billing-summary (~L1603) loops. Replace with: resolve `String currency = gcpCostService.getProjectCurrencyCode(projectId)` once per project; if currency is null/blank/USD use the native monthToDateSpend/forecastedSpend/lastMonthSpend/costHistory/billing figures unchanged; else set mtdUsd from gcpCostService.getUnfilteredMonthToDateSpendUsd(...) when present, compute effectiveRate = (mtdNative > 0 && mtdUsd present) ? mtdUsd/mtdNative : null, and when effectiveRate != null multiply forecast/lastMonth/each costHistory cost/each billing amount by effectiveRate; when effectiveRate == null fall back to the native figures and logger.warn once that project <id> reports <currency> but no USD conversion was available (parallel to the Azure warn). Do NOT scale optimizationSummary, savingsSummary, wastedResourceCount, activeAlertCount, securityScore, or resourceInventory — those are already USD/unitless.

Surface the GCP project currency so a reader can tell USD from converted (mirror Azure's currency field). Preferred minimal approach: keep the per-account subAccounts correct in USD (already set from mtdUsd/forecastUsd). If a DTO currency field is needed for the DTO-shape contract, add it on GcpDashboardData (Lombok @Data) analogous to AzureDashboardData.currency; otherwise it is sufficient that the aggregated Account cost figures are USD. Do not add currency to AWS or change AWS behaviour.

In mapAzureDataToDashboardData (~L3607), change `mainAccount.setForecastedSpend(azureData.getForecastedSpend())` so forecast matches the MTD currency: when azureData.getMonthToDateSpendUsd() != null and azureData.getMonthToDateSpend() > 0, set forecast = azureData.getForecastedSpend() * (monthToDateSpendUsd / monthToDateSpend) (the same effective billed rate as MTD); otherwise keep native forecast (correct for USD-billed). Apply the same effective-rate scaling to the Azure costHistory costs that feed the unified CostChart (the block that builds new DashboardData.CostHistory from azureData.getCostHistory()) and to lastMonthSpend if it is carried into the unified view. Leave the security-score, cost-anomaly, and waste code exactly as-is (do not regress prior Azure fixes).

Add backend tests (new class(es) under xamops-service/src/test/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/, constructor-mock style from GcpPricingCurrencyTest): a GCP unified-currency test proving (i) a USD-billed project's MTD is unchanged by aggregation (NOT ~/83) and (ii) a non-USD project uses the billed currency_conversion_rate, not the 83.0 constant; and an Azure test proving the mapped forecastedSpend is USD-consistent with monthToDateSpendUsd (forecast is no longer native when MTD is USD). Mock GcpCostService/currency as needed so no live credentials are required.
acceptance_criteria: DashboardDataService.aggregateGcpDashboardData contains no currencyConversionService.inrToUsd(...) calls; a USD-billed GCP project's MTD/forecast/history pass through without division by the 83.0 constant.
A non-USD GCP project is converted using GCP's currency_conversion_rate (billed rate), with project currency resolved via getProjectCurrencyCode and a warn logged only when USD is unavailable.
mapAzureDataToDashboardData sets forecastedSpend (and unified costHistory) in USD consistent with monthToDateSpendUsd; prior Azure security-score/anomaly/waste behaviour unchanged.
New GCP and Azure unified-currency tests pass (Failures: 0, Errors: 0).
verification: mvn -pl xamops-service test -Dtest=GcpPricingCurrencyTest (regression: GCP savings/pricing still USD, not double-converted)
findings:
Backend now emits GCP unified-dashboard cost in USD and aligns Azure forecast/history to USD. Details for FEAT-002 (frontend) and later steps:

NEW GcpCostService method (billed-rate USD MTD):
- public Optional<Double> getUnfilteredMonthToDateSpendUsd(String gcpProjectId)
- public Optional<Double> getUnfilteredMonthToDateSpendUsd(String gcpProjectId, boolean forceRefresh)
- Returns Optional.empty() when: project has no billing export, export lacks currency_conversion_rate (older exports -> query error treated as absence), query fails, or project is CSP/reseller (flattened dataset has no rate column). USD = SUM(cost/currency_conversion_rate) + credits/currency_conversion_rate.
- Distinct cache key prefix: "gcp:unfiltered-mtd-spend-usd:" (added alongside native "gcp:unfiltered-mtd-spend:" in both evictAllCostCaches redis+db prefix arrays).

DashboardDataService.aggregateGcpDashboardData:
- All three currencyConversionService.inrToUsd(...) calls removed (MTD/forecast/lastMonth) plus the two in the cost-history and billing-summary loops. currencyConversionService is still a field (used elsewhere) but no longer used in the GCP path.
- Per project: currency = gcpCostService.getProjectCurrencyCode(projectId). null/blank/USD => native pass-through (NOT divided by 83). Non-USD => mtdUsd from getUnfilteredMonthToDateSpendUsd; effectiveRate = mtdUsd/mtdNative (when mtdNative>0 and USD present); forecast/lastMonth/costHistory/billingSummary all scaled by effectiveRate. When USD unavailable: native pass-through + logger.warn once (parallel to Azure warn). optimizationSummary/savingsSummary/waste/alerts/securityScore/inventory NOT scaled.
- gcpCostService was added to DashboardDataService as an @Autowired field (NOT constructor param — the constructor is saturated; follows the iamPrivilegeAnalyzer field-injection precedent). No DTO/type signature changes were made to GcpDashboardData: the aggregated Account cost figures are now USD, which was sufficient for the DTO-shape contract (no new currency field added to GcpDashboardData or DashboardData.Account). So FEAT-002 does NOT need a new optional currency field on the GCP frontend type for this change — it simply must STOP applying convertToUSD to GCP in useUnifiedDashboard.ts (backend GCP is now USD, mirroring how Azure is already passed through un-converted).

mapAzureDataToDashboardData:
- MTD already = monthToDateSpendUsd ?? native. Added azureEffectiveRate = (monthToDateSpendUsd != null && native > 0) ? usd/native : null. forecastedSpend now scaled by azureEffectiveRate (else native). costHistory COSTS scaled by azureEffectiveRate; the third CostHistory arg (getForecast(), a List<Boolean> of forecast-point flags, NOT cost values) passes through unchanged. Security-score/anomaly/waste code untouched. New private helper: scaleCosts(List<Double>, double) (null-safe, preserves null entries).

Tests added (constructor-mock + Objenesis-allocate + reflection on the private methods; no live creds):
- xamops-service/src/test/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/GcpUnifiedCurrencyTest.java (3 tests)
- xamops-service/src/test/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/AzureForecastCurrencyTest.java (2 tests)
